channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Rock Block K
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Rock Block K (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block K: Block K's record and map shape now say: the Design Controls give Block K as 139 x 144 ft (not exactly the 139 x 143 ft lobe); the 120 ft height is tied for lowest residential height with Flex Blocks H, I and J; the earlier statement that the lots match the plan within 3% is corrected by a new dated note; the unconfirmed satellite-imagery statement is flagged; the shape's notes no longer call the block 'D4D-adopted'; the phase-status fact no longer implies Block K is in Phase 2 and includes the June 2026 Resolution 26-34; the Sept 2019 approval is described as Port staff finding the boundary change met the DDA criteria; the Jan 30, 2018, Oct 10, 2023 and March 11, 2025 Port Commission actions cite the minutes and misquoted wording was corrected; and source citations were fixed. The shape is unchanged.
item.description: Block K's record and map shape now say: the Design Controls give Block K as 139 x 144 ft (not exactly the 139 x 143 ft lobe); the 120 ft height is tied for lowest residential height with Flex Blocks H, I and J; the earlier statement that the lots match the plan within 3% is corrected by a new dated note; the unconfirmed satellite-imagery statement is flagged; the shape's notes no longer call the block 'D4D-adopted'; the phase-status fact no longer implies Block K is in Phase 2 and includes the June 2026 Resolution 26-34; the Sept 2019 approval is described as Port staff finding the boundary change met the DDA criteria; the Jan 30, 2018, Oct 10, 2023 and March 11, 2025 Port Commission actions cite the minutes and misquoted wording was corrected; and source citations were fixed. The shape is unchanged. Source: Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Design Controls, 2018-04-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Phase 2 update (Port Commission Item 11A), 2026-06-09 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2018-01-30 (https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download), 2023-10-10 (https://www.sfport.com/media/9218/download?inline), 2025-03-11 (https://www.sfport.com/media/10376/download?inline), 2026-06-09 (https://www.sfport.com/media/11337/download?inline).

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block K: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03, 18-04'. Port sources number the Design Controls resolution differently (the Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested it as 18-04; the Sept 2019 Port memo numbers it 18.05), and the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10 as adopted, so the milestone now cites that range.
item.description: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03, 18-04'. Port sources number the Design Controls resolution differently (the Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested it as 18-04; the Sept 2019 Port memo numbers it 18.05), and the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10 as adopted, so the milestone now cites that range. Source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, Jan 30 2018 (https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 11A staff report, 2018-01-26 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Mission%20Rock%20Approvals%20Staff%20Report%201-26-18FINAL.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block K: Port staff say later phases 'may require higher percentages of BMR units' to reach the project's 40% target after Phase 1 was cut to 132 BMR units; the Port, developer and MOHCD are reviewing changes 'with the goal of improving the feasibility of future Phases of Mission Rock and accelerating development' (Resolution 25-17) (Mar 11, 2025)
item.description: Port staff say later phases 'may require higher percentages of BMR units' to reach the project's 40% target after Phase 1 was cut to 132 BMR units; the Port, developer and MOHCD are reviewing changes 'with the goal of improving the feasibility of future Phases of Mission Rock and accelerating development' (Resolution 25-17) (Mar 11, 2025). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-07; Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-11.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-07; Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-11

item.title: Planned · Mission Rock Block K: Port Commission adopts Resolution 23-46 (passed unanimously as amended, with non-substantive changes); its recitals state that Phase 2 is 'not currently financially feasible' and that Port and Developer staff 'mutually agreed earlier this year to decelerate work on Phase 2 while waiting for macroeconomic conditions to improve' (Oct 10, 2023)
item.description: Port Commission adopts Resolution 23-46 (passed unanimously as amended, with non-substantive changes); its recitals state that Phase 2 is 'not currently financially feasible' and that Port and Developer staff 'mutually agreed earlier this year to decelerate work on Phase 2 while waiting for macroeconomic conditions to improve' (Oct 10, 2023). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-10.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-10

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block K: Developer sends the Port its Phase 2 Submittal (with a Garage Report submitted October 14, 2022 and a Basis of Design November 18, 2022); the budget and appraisal elements are deferred (Dec 28, 2022)
item.description: Developer sends the Port its Phase 2 Submittal (with a Garage Report submitted October 14, 2022 and a Basis of Design November 18, 2022); the budget and appraisal elements are deferred (Dec 28, 2022). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block K: Port Commission approves the Phase 1 budget with the K-for-F swap (Resolution 19-39); Port staff, not the Commission, found that the boundary change met the DDA's criteria for a phase boundary change (Sep 24, 2019)
item.description: Port Commission approves the Phase 1 budget with the K-for-F swap (Resolution 19-39); Port staff, not the Commission, found that the boundary change met the DDA's criteria for a phase boundary change (Sep 24, 2019). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2019-09-24.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block K: Developer proposes moving Parcel K to a later phase and bringing Parcel F into Phase 1 instead, for about 100 more units, about 40 more affordable, and a four-corner intersection (Jul 2, 2019)
item.description: Developer proposes moving Parcel K to a later phase and bringing Parcel F into Phase 1 instead, for about 100 more units, about 40 more affordable, and a four-corner intersection (Jul 2, 2019). Source: Mission Rock Partners (developer's submittal to the Port), 2019-07-02; SocketSite, 2019-07-19.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block K: Development Agreement and DDA take effect; DA term 30 years, project planned in up to four phases (Aug 15, 2018)
item.description: Development Agreement and DDA take effect; DA term 30 years, project planned in up to four phases (Aug 15, 2018). Source: SF Planning; Port of San Francisco, 2021-06-24.
